# Ideas

## Purpose

Hold raw, half-formed thoughts and speculative claims for this topic before they are evidence-backed.

## What belongs here

- Early hypotheses and questions
- Sketches of arguments not yet ready for `notes/`
- Pointers to inbox items that were promoted into this topic

## What does not belong here

- Normative “shall” language (that belongs in `specifications/`)
- Venue-ready prose or abstracts
- Literature summaries (use `literature/`)
- Accepted architectural decisions (use `architecture/`)

## Naming conventions

- `YYYY-MM-DD-<short-slug>.md` or `<short-slug>.md` if dated in frontmatter
- kebab-case only
- Frontmatter `type: idea`, `status: active` (or `inbox` if still unowned)

## Graduation

When an idea has a clear claim and some grounding, move or rewrite it into `notes/` and leave a one-line pointer if useful.
